states.name: Stationary
states.criterion: Waiting in place / adjustment steps or bouncing the ball before a serve, no take-back yet; small position noise is not a separate state.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Left
states.criterion: Feet and body shift to the left of the frame, racket ready, no clear take-back yet.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Right
states.criterion: Feet and body shift to the right of the frame, racket ready, no clear take-back yet.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Forward
states.criterion: Approaches the net, judged with the court lines and body position; no swing starts in this segment.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Back
states.criterion: Body moves back from inside the court towards the baseline, judged with the court lines; not classified just by moving down in the frame.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Forehand
states.criterion: Right-hand take-back guided by the other hand, swinging across the body; includes follow-through recovery; not decided by sideways movement.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Backhand
states.criterion: Both hands take the racket back on the left of the body, follow through up and to the right; includes recovery.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation

states.name: Serve
states.criterion: Full visible sequence of toss, both arms up, overhead swing and landing recovery.
states.source: fixed definition; this video’s evidence is listed per activation
